name: Jimi Hendrix
hook: An American guitarist who had to go to London to become famous, and who changed what an electric guitar could sound like in four years.
blurb: Jimi Hendrix grew up in Seattle and played guitar in other people's backing bands in the United States. In 1966 Chas Chandler of the Animals brought him to London, where he formed the Jimi Hendrix Experience and became a star within months, so his route to fame ran through London's scene rather than America's, which is why his connection on this map comes from Swinging London. He used feedback, distortion and effects pedals as part of the music, moved sounds across the stereo, and recorded guitar parts backwards on tape, which puts him with the Beatles as someone who used the studio as an instrument. Hip-hop producers later sampled him: Cypress Hill looped a guitar lick from 'Are You Experienced?'. His time as a headliner lasted under four years. He died in London in 1970, aged 27.
